Name: Binny Bansal
Bio: Binny Bansal is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Binny co-founded Flipkart, India's leading e-commerce marketplace in 2007. As CEO, he played a pivotal role in scaling the company, culminating in Walmart's USD 20 billion acquisition of Flipkart in 2018, then the largest global Merger and Acquisition deal in e-commerce. Post-Flipkart, he has focused on investing in and mentoring startups. He also co-founded xto10x Technologies, a company that helps businesses scale globally. He actively advises and serves on the boards of multiple startups and organizations. A philanthropist at heart, Binny's foundation is supporting various initiatives in the areas of entrepreneurship, education and improving livelihoods.
